column1: # The concordance of world-1.bin (WN0, E2): which HS 2022 subheadings are which of the game's goods, for BACI's trade.
# WHY: BACI counts HS6 subheadings; the game has sixty traded goods. The longest hs prefix (2, 4 or 6 digits) that matches a subheading wins; good - means that prefix maps to nothing,

# so a chapter can be taken whole and a heading carved out of it. share splits a subheading's tonnes among goods and vshare its value (default share; - for that): the shares for one prefix sum to 1 each.
# Most of HS maps to nothing (chemicals, textiles, electronics, gold, gas); only what is a good in the game's sense is here.
